_about: Explore Actions panel content. 'actions' holds one entry per kind of action/space (order here = order on screen; 'section' picks the header). Text may use {revives} (Pokémon Center revives) and {returnTo} (the Battle Frontier's return city, read from the map). An action only shows on a region's panel if that region's board has it. 'regions.<region>.<action id>' overrides name/desc/icon for just that map -- use it for the game-specific sprites. An empty override value is ignored, so a blank "icon" is safe to leave as a template. Icons are image URLs (or paths relative to index.html); with none, a placeholder square shows.

gym-battle.name: Gym Battle
gym-battle.desc: Challenge the Gym Leader named on this space. Winning earns their Badge; once you hold it the action shows as defeated. Some Gyms stay locked until you meet a requirement, and the prompt says what.

villain-battle.name: Villain Battle
villain-battle.desc: Battle the villain team leader named on this space. Like a Gym Battle, it is marked defeated once you have won it.

elite-four-battle.name: Battle Elite Four
elite-four-battle.desc: Face one of the region’s Elite Four. You choose which member to battle, or pick Random.

champion-battle.name: Battle Champion
champion-battle.desc: Take on the region’s Champion, usually the last battle of the journey.

victory.name: Enter the Hall of Fame
victory.desc: Enter the Hall of Fame to win the game. It unlocks once you have defeated the Champion; the prompt tells you if it is still locked.

poke-mart.name: Poké Mart
poke-mart.desc: Draw one card from the Item deck.

pokemon-center.name: Pokémon Center
pokemon-center.desc: Heals your team: every Status Condition is removed and up to {revives} Fainted Pokémon are revived. If more than that are Fainted, you choose which ones.

department-store.name: Department Store
department-store.desc: Look at the top 2 cards of the Item deck and keep one in your hand. The other goes to the bottom of the deck.

safari-zone.name: Safari Zone
safari-zone.desc: Discard an Item card from your hand to enter, then choose a Yellow Pokémon from the pool and roll the Catch Die. A Catch Total of 4 or more catches it (2 or more if you discarded a Safari Ball), whatever the Pokémon’s own Catch Value. No Catch Cards can be played. A caught Pokémon joins your team and leaves the game; one that gets away goes back to the pool.

battle-frontier.name: Battle Frontier
battle-frontier.desc:
Choose a token color (Legendary is the orange tokens) and a random Pokémon of that color is drawn as the Defender. It can’t be caught. Defeat it to claim that color’s reward:
Pink: a Pokémon that gained a Level from the battle gains an additional Level.
Green: draw a card from the Item deck.
Blue: look at the top 2 cards of the Item deck and keep one; the other goes to the bottom.
Yellow: draw 3 Yellow Pokémon, choose one and try to Catch it with a +2 bonus on the roll.
Red: look at the top 3 cards of the Item deck and keep one, then a Pokémon below Level 5 gains a Level.
Legendary: take one Item card from the deck or the discard pile, then a Pokémon below Level 5 gains a Level. Once per player.
If you lose, or end the battle without defeating it, your marker moves to {returnTo}.

gain-item.name: Gain Item
gain-item.desc: Take the named Item card into your hand for free. Once you have claimed it the action shows as gained.

roll-for-item.name: Roll For Item
roll-for-item.desc: Roll a d6. Each space has its own table that says which item (if any) that number gives you.

catch-space.name: Catch Space
catch-space.desc: A coloured circle holding a face-down wild Pokémon. Land on it and choose Encounter it to reveal the Pokémon, then battle and try to catch it, or walk away and leave it face-up for the next visitor.

event-space.name: Event Space
event-space.desc: Land here to draw a card from the Event deck.

city-space.name: City
city-space.desc: Where the actions above are found. Stopping in or passing through a city lets you set it as your Current Home.
